messages:
ali: Night idea  tiny karaoke + manga swap? 1hr slots, low pressure. anyone in for midnight vibes tonight?
samira: yes! low-key. will do ukulele for one song. :ukulele:
mike: count me in. i will belt something embarrassingly earnest. recommendations for playlist to warm up?
juno: make it 80s ballads + one upbeat guilty pleasure. perfect sleepy crowd.
kara-bot: Suggested warm-up mix: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/5WarmupExample (80s ballads + indie singalongs) :notes:
tess: manga swap recs: "Solanin" for moody real-life vibes, "Yotsuba&!" for levity, and "Uzumaki" if anyone wants the opposite of cozy.
ali: love that spread. plan: 12:00am start, quick intros, 3 people sing, then swap 1-volume manga picks via DM. low-commitment.
mike: I'll do one earnest slow song, then hand off to @samira for ukulele cover.
samira: thinking a stripped-down "Friday I'm in Love" ukulele -> maybe too cursed? :laughing:
juno: perfect. also, if we want to pair reading moods, i suggest reading "Solanin" chapter 2 while playing the kara-bot playlist shuffle. it's 10-15min, great palate cleanser.
tess: trivia twist: whoever sings a song related to their manga pick gets dessert provided by the organizer (i volunteer to bring cookies).
ali: cookies is now official incentive. :cookie:
kara-bot: Event created: "Midnight Karaoke & Manga Swap" 1850012400 (Tonight 12:00am local). Reminder set 1850011200 (20m before).
mike: RSVP: yes. dietary note: peanut-free cookies please.
tess: noted, bringing oat chocolate chip.
samira: quick tech note: i'll set up a tiny OBS scene for streaming audio + camera. paste this in OBS browser for lyrics overlay: ```https://lyrics-overlay.example.com/room/ali-midnight```
juno: good call. i'll bring a short ambient loop (sea + vinyl) to pad transitions.
ali: two more spots if anyone else wants to sing a 1-song slot.
mike: filling the last spot with my big finale. :microphone:
tess: will DM manga exchange order and my cookie recipe.
ali: perfect. thanks team. this thread took my Friday from plain to <very good>. see you midnight. :stars:
